title: Problem 2.27 — Bar-Natan’s radical question for finite-type link invariants
statement: (D. Bar-Natan) Is there a similar statement for finite type invariants of links? Let I be an ideal in the algebra V of finite type invariants of links. Let Z be the set of links that are annihilated by all members of I, and let J be the ideal in V of all invariants that vanish on Z. Clearly, J always contains the radical of I. Are they always equal?
